definitions.gloss: reckless driving; driving wildly out of control
definitions.explanation: Dangerous, uncontrolled driving of a vehicle, typically at high speed and without regard for traffic rules or safety. Often used in news reports about traffic incidents.
Running about in a disorderly or chaotic manner, without direction or control. Can refer to people, animals, or figuratively to things spiraling out of control.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{乱走|らんそう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{歩道|ほどう}→歩道：03723_hodou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{突|つ}っ{込|こ}んだ→突っ込む：07000_tsukkomu⟧。
examples.english: The car went out of control and crashed into the sidewalk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暴走族|ぼうそうぞく}→暴走族：23108_bousouzoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{乱走|らんそう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A biker gang drove recklessly through the city late at night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飲酒|いんしゅ}{運転|うんてん}→飲酒運転：18486_inshuunten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{住宅街|じゅうたくがい}→住宅街：09394_juutakugai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{乱走|らんそう}し、⟦{複数|ふくすう}→複数：14236_fukusuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車両|しゃりょう}→車両：05297_sharyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{衝突|しょうとつ}する→衝突する：26785_shoutotsusuru⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: A drunk-driving car drove recklessly through a residential area, causing an accident involving multiple vehicles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{乱走|らんそう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A dog is running around wildly in the park.

examples.english: The children ran around wildly in the classroom and were scolded by the teacher.

examples.japanese: ⟦パニック→パニック：11171_panikku⟧になった⟦{馬|うま}→馬：01865_uma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{乱走|らんそう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}かせた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: The panicked horse ran amok, startling the people around it.

notes:
A compound of {乱|らん} (disorder/chaos) and {走|そう} (run). Describes uncontrolled, dangerous movement, most commonly applied to vehicles. In news reporting, {乱走|らんそう} typically implies a vehicle that has gone out of control and poses danger to bystanders.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{乱走|らんそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: a car runs out of control
- {乱走|らんそう}⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧: accident caused by reckless driving
- {街中|まちなか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{乱走|らんそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: drive/run wildly through the streets

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{暴走|ぼうそう}→暴走：09481_bousou⟧: reckless driving; running out of control (more common, emphasizes violent or dangerous speed)
- ⟦{蛇行|だこう}→蛇行：09036_dakou⟧: weaving; swerving (driving in a zigzag pattern)
- ⟦{逃走|とうそう}→逃走：14403_tousou⟧: fleeing; running away (running to escape, not necessarily reckless)
